narrations.en: Step 7, pages 10 to 11. Since multiplying two real numbers with the same sign always results in 0 or more, for a positive number a, the formula can be derived without any gaps according to the principle that two numbers (+ root a, -root a) with the same absolute value and opposite signs are squared to obtain a. narrations.es: Paso 7, páginas 10 a 11.
